answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity in a resource that is costly but verifiable, like proof-of-work heat rising as a visible plume. Layered identity then behaves like shale: old, settled attestations form dense strata that new accounts cannot fake instantly. Nectar rewards flow only through attested edges, so flooding with fresh sybils yields no flow — the honey stays in established channels, and slashing makes bulk fake identity a net loss.
